disclosure.direction_is_against_interest: Stratifying adds four conditions and makes the floor harder. The image route is worse than the text route for 7 of 8 candidates on retain-other row-micro, so the extension enlarges the failure it reports.
disclosure.pooled_was_computed_and_not_adopted: Pooling, stratifying and dropping the image route were all computed. Stratifying is frozen because pooling averages two instruments that measurably disagree; the pooled numbers are in this report so the choice is visible rather than asserted.
disclosure.what_stratifying_does_not_do: It does not enlarge any denominator. Each of the eight numbers still sits on 408 or 76 queries. The pooled all-routes rate, which does double n, is reported beside the decision and floors nothing.

purpose: What an eight-number, route-stratified retention floor says about the candidates and replicates that already exist, and the floor Stage 2 will be judged on. Re-decides nothing.
